summary: NextDecade Corp's subsidiary Rio Grande LNG completed a $3.5B senior secured notes offering across four tranches (5.250%-6.150% due 2031-2041), net proceeds to repay existing credit facility borrowings and fees. The offering was conducted under Rule 144A/Reg S; notes are unregistered and secured. This is a routine debt refinancing/issuance, not a special situation triggering any M&A, activist, or restructuring event. No deal terms for a change-of-control event are reported; the filing is a routine capital markets transaction.
